description: Angular component for adding API keys in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, expiration time calculation, and API interaction.

classes.name: AddApiKeyDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for creating and managing API keys, with form controls and expiration logic.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Collects form data, computes expiration time, and saves a new API key via the service.

methods.name: isCustomExpirationTime
methods.description: Checks if the expiration time is set to 'custom'.

methods.name: onExpirationDateChange
methods.description: Enables or disables the custom expiration time input based on selection.

methods.name: calcExpirationTime
methods.description: Calculates the expiration timestamp based on form input.
